title: Corrective fix for B-3e9fde9b: Shared final review
description:
Blocked reason: docs/architecture.md "Not instrumented" section (lines 930–933) states ShoppingListDocument is not instrumented and must not depend on an app-level logger, but ShoppingListDocument.swift (in CookbookCore) has import os and a private Logger at lines 2–4 and uses it at lines 155–157. The code and documentation directly contradict each other. Resolution: update architecture.md to remove ShoppingListDocument from "Not instrumented" and document the intentional private-logger design (avoids cross-package dependency on Loggers namespace). No code change required if the documentation path is chosen.

Remaining work: One finding must be resolved: docs/architecture.md "Not instrumented" section says ShoppingListDocument is not instrumented, but the code has import os and a private Logger. Either remove the logger from ShoppingListDocument (code change) or update the architecture.md "Not instrumented" section to document the intentional private-logger exception (documentation change). The design decision in the handoff justifies the implementation; the doc just needs to match.
